programmes.d: Ji-hoo can see how hurt Jan Di is by the kiss, and continues to follow her as she stumbles around in shock.
Jun-pyo begins seeing Jae-Kyung in a new light, like he's seeing her for the first time as a potential friend -- or maybe a kindred spirit.
Woo-bin tries to talk some sense into Yi-jung, who is determined to drink himself into a stupor.
At home, Jun-hee reminisces about how her mother meddled in her life, in much the same way she's interfering in Jun-pyo's now.
Yi-jung is waiting outside for Eun-jae, excited to see her -- until he listens in on her phone conversation; from her words, it sounds like a call to a boyfriend.
Jun-pyo begs for Jan Di to advise him not to get married.
Jun-pyo tells Jan Di that he'll protect her, but to Jun-pyo's surprise, she says that she does not want to be cosseted or taken care of.
Perhaps feeling it's time to expose one truth, Mr. Jung leads Jun-hee to the unknown patient's bedside; at the sight of her father, Jun-hee breaks down.
Jun-pyo asks Yumi to make the lunchbox once more, confirming that Yumi had taken credit for her lunch.
Just being rich isn't enough to endure the teen oppression at Shinhwa -- loners are often marked as targets by the bored über-clique called F4.
A wicked rumor is spread on the Internet that a second-year student at Shinhwa High School is pregnant.
Not too eager to watch Jan Di dancing with one of his best friends, Jun Pyo exits the ballroom and ends up taking out his frustrations by the poolside.
Making a rash choice, Jan Di tells her mother she has to go somewhere and runs off, heading toward Namsan Tower.
Jan Di's bike is set ablaze while she is attacked with water balloons and blasted with a fire extinguisher.
A psychic foresees that Jan Di will be losing something significant.
Jun Pyo intends to expel his best friend and Jan Di out of Shinhwa High School -- and out of F4.

programmes.t: I Hate Asians: A Shootout in Albuquerque
programmes.d: Investigating the murder of Sihui Fang, a 45-year-old Chinese immigrant pursuing the American dream.
Jan Di dashes to the hospital after being informed that Jun Pyo had been in an accident.
Yi-jung gets a frantic call from his mother threatening to commit suicide because of his father.
